mapper.sql: select competition_id, competition_name, description, competition_type, competition_link, banner_image, announcement, learning_link, learning_image, learning_description, learning_count, register_start_time, register_end_time, create_time, update_time from competition
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN register_start_time > NOW() THEN 1 END) AS not_started, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOW() BETWEEN register_start_time AND register_end_time THEN 1 END) AS in_progress, COUNT(CASE WHEN register_end_time < NOW() THEN 1 END) AS ended FROM competition

select c.competition_id, c.competition_name, c.description, c.competition_type, c.competition_link, c.banner_image, c.announcement, c.learning_link, c.learning_image, c.learning_description, c.learning_count, c.register_start_time, c.register_end_time, c.create_time, c.update_time, coalesce(tc.team_count, 0) as team_count from competition c left join ( select competition_id, count(distinct team_id) as team_count from competition_register where team_id is not null group by competition_id ) tc on tc.competition_id = c.competition_id
AND c.competition_name like concat('%', #{competitionName}, '%')
AND c.competition_type like concat('%', #{competitionType}, '%')
AND c.register_start_time > NOW() AND NOW() BETWEEN c.register_start_time AND c.register_end_time AND c.register_end_time < NOW()
order by c.create_time desc
select distinct competition_type from competition where competition_type is not null and competition_type != '' order by competition_type asc

AND (competition_name like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%') OR description like concat('%', #{filters.keyword}, '%'))
AND trim(competition_type) = trim(#{filters.type})
AND ( competition_name like concat('%', '全国', '%') OR competition_name like concat('%', '国家', '%') OR description like concat('%', '全国', '%') OR description like concat('%', '国家', '%') OR description like concat('%', '教育部', '%') OR description like concat('%', '部委', '%') )
AND ( competition_name like concat('%', '省赛', '%') OR competition_name like concat('%', '市赛', '%') OR description like concat('%', '省赛', '%') OR description like concat('%', '市赛', '%') OR description like concat('%', '省级', '%') OR description like concat('%', '市级', '%') OR description like concat('%', '区域', '%') )
AND ( competition_name like concat('%', '校赛', '%') OR description like concat('%', '校赛', '%') OR description like concat('%', '校级', '%') )
AND NOW() BETWEEN register_start_time AND register_end_time
AND (NOW() < register_start_time OR NOW() > register_end_time)
AND ( competition_name like concat('%', '团队', '%') OR competition_name like concat('%', '组队', '%') OR competition_name like concat('%', '团体', '%') OR description like concat('%', '团队', '%') OR description like concat('%', '组队', '%') OR description like concat('%', '团体', '%') )
AND ( competition_name like concat('%', '个人', '%') OR description like concat('%', '个人', '%') )
order by create_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select c.*, (select count(distinct t.team_id) from competition_register t where t.competition_id = c.competition_id and t.team_id is not null) as team_count from competition c where c.competition_id = #{competitionId}

AND (competition_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND register_start_time > NOW() AND NOW() BETWEEN register_start_time AND register_end_time AND register_end_time < NOW()
order by create_time desc
SELECT reviewer_name, score, comment, score_time FROM competition_score WHERE participation_id = #{participationId} ORDER BY score_time DESC
mapper.insert: insert into competition ( competition_name, description, competition_type, competition_link, banner_image, announcement, learning_link, learning_image, learning_description,register_start_time, register_end_time, create_time ) values ( #{competitionName}, #{description}, #{competitionType}, #{competitionLink}, #{bannerImage}, #{announcement}, #{learningLink}, #{learningImage}, #{learningDescription},#{registerStartTime}, #{registerEndTime}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.register_id as registerId, r.team_name as teamName, r.team_members as teamMembers, r.work_name as workName, r.work_description as workDescription, r.teacher_name as teacherName, r.register_time as registerTime, (SELECT AVG(score) FROM competition_score WHERE participation_id = r.register_id) as avgScore FROM competition_register r WHERE r.register_id = #{registerId}
